reason: A utility plugin that estimates DeepSeek conversation costs and displays the DeepSeek account balance in the composer stats row, using the configured DeepSeek balance API.

summaries.zh: 在编辑器统计栏中显示 DeepSeek 会话费用估算和账户余额，并支持定时刷新余额。
summaries.en: Displays estimated DeepSeek conversation costs and account balance in the composer stats row with periodic balance refreshes.

capabilities: Reads configured DeepSeek API credentials through the credentials service
Sends authenticated requests to the DeepSeek balance endpoint
Displays estimated conversation token costs and account balance in the composer UI
Automatically refreshes balance data every 60 seconds
